description.id: PROMIND mengelola Office Building, Apartment, Mall, dan kawasan Real Estate: operasional gedung, engineering, HSE, dan layanan tenant dalam satu kemitraan.
description.en: PROMIND manages office buildings, apartments, malls, and real estate: building operations, engineering, HSE, and tenant services under one partnership.

title.id: Pengelolaan Properti yang Terukur, Rapi, dan Berkelanjutan.
title.en: Structured, Reliable, and Sustainable Property Management.

description.id: PROMIND mendampingi pemilik aset dalam mengelola operasional Office Building, Apartment, Mall, dan kawasan Real Estate secara menyeluruh—didukung oleh tim lapangan berpengalaman serta sistem operasional digital terintegrasi.
description.en: PROMIND partners with asset owners to manage the daily operations of Office Buildings, Apartments, Malls, and Real Estate developments—combining experienced on-site teams with an integrated digital operational support system.

title.id: Menjaga Kualitas Fisik Bangunan Sekaligus Kenyamanan Setiap Penggunanya.
title.en: Preserving Physical Building Quality While Ensuring Occupant Comfort.

body.id: Pengelolaan gedung yang baik membutuhkan konsistensi setiap hari. Mulai dari kesiapan mesin mekanikal-elektrikal, kebersihan area publik, ketertiban keamanan, hingga administrasi keuangan yang rapi—kami memastikan seluruh aspek operasional berjalan selaras dengan target pemilik properti.
body.en: Effective building management requires daily consistency. From mechanical and electrical readiness, clean public spaces, and disciplined security to transparent financial administration—we ensure every operational aspect aligns with the property owner's objectives.

title.id: Pengelolaan yang Disesuaikan dengan Karakter Setiap Aset.
title.en: Management Tailored to the Character of Every Asset.

subtitle.id: Setiap jenis properti memiliki tuntutan operasional yang berbeda. Kami menyusun struktur tim, prosedur kerja, dan standar layanan sesuai kebutuhan spesifik aset Anda.
subtitle.en: Different property types demand distinct operational priorities. We structure our on-site teams, standard operating procedures, and service standards around your asset's specific profile.

title.id: Standar Kerja yang Diterapkan Langsung oleh Tim Operasional.
title.en: Working Standards Applied Directly by Our On-Site Teams.

subtitle.id: Kualitas manajemen properti terlihat dari disiplin pelaksanaan di lapangan—mulai dari inspeksi rutin hingga pelayanan harian kepada pengguna gedung.
subtitle.en: The quality of property management is proven in daily field execution—from routine technical inspections to responsive occupant service.

title.id: Operasional Gedung Lebih Terkontrol dengan Dukungan Sistem Terintegrasi.
title.en: Better Controlled Building Operations Supported by Integrated Systems.

description.id: Sebagai pendukung digital operasional building management, sistem kami membantu tim di lapangan dan manajemen memantau aktivitas harian secara terstruktur—tanpa menggantikan sentuhan layanan manusia.
description.en: As a digital operational support system for building management, our platform helps field teams and management monitor daily activities in a structured manner—complementing hands-on human service.

summary.id: Jadwal perawatan mesin M&E, patroli keamanan, dan pemeriksaan kebersihan tercatat secara digital sehingga pelaksanaan kerja di lapangan lebih terukur.
summary.en: M&E maintenance schedules, security patrols, and housekeeping checks are logged digitally so field execution remains measurable.

summary.id: Setiap laporan atau permintaan layanan dari pengguna gedung terdata dengan jelas, memudahkan koordinasi tindak lanjut oleh tim teknis di lokasi.
summary.en: Every service request from building occupants is clearly recorded, streamlining follow-up coordination by on-site technical teams.

summary.id: Mendukung kerapian administrasi penagihan utilitas, iuran pengelolaan, serta penyajian laporan berkala yang transparan bagi pemilik gedung.
summary.en: Supports organized utility invoicing, service charge administration, and transparent periodic reporting for property owners.

title.id: Konsultan & Layanan Pengelolaan Properti Terintegrasi di Indonesia.
title.en: Integrated Property and Estate Management in Indonesia.

id: PT PROPERTI MANAJEMEN INOVASI INDONESIA (PROMIND) adalah perusahaan konsultan dan layanan manajemen properti di Indonesia yang didirikan pada tahun 2013, menghadirkan layanan terintegrasi dan profesional untuk memaksimalkan nilai aset serta menciptakan lingkungan hunian dan kerja yang lebih baik bagi klien kami.

Kami mendampingi pemilik aset di berbagai kelas properti—meliputi Office Building, Apartment, Mall, dan kawasan Real Estate—dengan memadukan sumber daya manusia berpengalaman serta standar kerja yang telah teruji.

Dengan penerapan sistem manajemen berstandar ISO (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), SMK3 PP No. 50 Tahun 2012, serta dukungan Building Management System (BMS), PROMIND memastikan operasional gedung berjalan efektif, efisien, aman, dan berkelanjutan.
en: PT PROPERTI MANAJEMEN INOVASI INDONESIA (PROMIND) is a property management consultant and service provider in Indonesia, established in 2013. We deliver integrated, professional services that maximize asset value and create better places to live and work.

We partner with asset owners across the main property sectors, including office buildings, apartments, malls, and real estate developments, combining experienced people with proven management standards.

Guided by management system standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), SMK3 under Government Regulation No. 50 of 2012, and integrated Building Management Systems (BMS), PROMIND runs property operations that are reliable, efficient, safe, and sustainable.
